'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Come on in, kid. Got anything interesting to tell? Eh, forget it, don't want to listen about your war. Got enough of it here. I don't have much to teach you anymore, you know how to stand up for yourself, and you know of justice well. Met the local bandit leaders too. But have you tried getting them all at once? The task in not an easy one, but the goal is worth it. The most important thing is what mark we leave behind us.}}

==Requirements== 
* Obtain level 4 loyalty with [[Jaeger]]

==Objectives==
* Eliminate [[Tagilla]]
* Eliminate [[Killa]]
* Eliminate [[Reshala]]
* Eliminate [[Shturman]]
* Eliminate [[Glukhar]]
* Eliminate [[Sanitar]]

==Rewards==
* Quest Rewards

** '''Unknown Reward'''

==Failure Dialogue==
{{quote|Couldn't handle it, I figure? Don't worry, I don't blame you, boy, it's not an easy task. So go on, recuperate and come back.}}

==Guide==
In this quest you have to kill all described bosses in one "life". This means that you have to kill them all, and extract successfully to complete the quest. For the locations of the bosses check their respective pages.
